name: May 21, 2024 Regular Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  MAY 21, 2024
  MULTIPURPOSE ROOM
  6:30 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Vice Chair Guldimann called the meeting t0 order at 6:31 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Vice Chair Suzanne Guldimann; Commissioners Georgia Goldfarb (arrived at
  6:53 p.m.), Jake Lingo, Alicia Peak, and Dane Skophammer (arrived at 6:35 p.m.)

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; Chris Orosz, Recreation
  Supervisor; and Brittany Saleaumua, Administrative Assistant

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Vice Chair Guldimann led the Pledge of Allegiance.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Commissioner Peak moved, and Commissioner Lingo seconded a motion to
  approve the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 3-0;
  Commissioners Goldfarb (arrived at 6:53 p.m.) and Skophammer (arrived at 6:35
  p.m.) were absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported the agenda for the meeting was
  posted on May l6, 2024.

ITEM 1  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  None.

  Commissioner Skophammer arrived at 6:35 p.m.

ITEM 2  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  John Alfano, Malibu Little League (MLL) President, addressed the Commission
  with his concerns regarding irrigation, field access, and maintenance projects. He
   Parks and Recreation Commission
  Regular Meeting
  Minutes of May 21, 2024
  Page 2 of 4

  stated there was a lack of support from the City and was disappointed that the
  scoreboards would not be installed during the 2024 season.

  In response to Commissioner Peak, Mr. Alfano stated that the scoreboards were
  purchased 18 months ago. He stated that it had been a lengthy process to schedule
  and secure permits to install them.

  In response to Vice Chair Guldimann, Community Services Director Riesgo stated
  staff were missing insurance documentation and a signed agreement from MLL for
  the scoreboard project.

  In response to Commissioner Lingo, Recreation Supervisor Orosz stated the
  contractor’s insurance lapsed, and an updated insurance certificate was not
  provided.

  Commissioner Lingo stated MLL had requested a meeting but did not receive a
  response from staff.

  Vice Chair Guldimann stated the item was not on the Agenda and MLL should
  collaborate with staff to move forward with the scoreboard project.

  Commissioner Goldfarb arrived at 6:53 p.m.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Commissioner Lingo moved, and Commissioner Peak seconded a motion to
  approve the Consent Calendar. The question wascalled, and the motion carried
  unanimously.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:
  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  l.  Community Services Department Monthly Report
  Recommended Action: Receive and file a report of activities, events,
  projects, and programs coordinated by the Community Services Department
  in April 2024.

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  None.
   Parks and Recreation Commission
  Regular Meeting
  Minutes of May 21, 2024
  Page 3 of 4

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  Youth Sports Organizational Facilitv Use

  Recommended Action: Receive and file a report regarding local youth sports
  organization registration data and facility use.

  Recreation Supervisor Orosz presented the staff report.

  In response to Commissioner Peak, Recreation Supervisor Orosz stated all Malibu
  addresses were considered residents. He stated staffdid not have or verify addresses
  to determine whether participants lived within City limits or in unincorporated
  areas.

  In response to Commissioner Goldfarb, Recreation Supervisor Orosz stated
  registration numbers for the 2019-2020 seasons were on file, but he did not have
  them available at the meeting.

  Commissioner Lingo stated Malibu Little League participation was increasing due
  to the expansion of the softball program.

  Commissioner Peak stated softball would join the USA Softball League and field
  use requests would be earlier in the year beginning in 2025.

  Commissioner Lingo stated MLL used the Malibu High School softball field. He
  stated MLL would propose a plan for softball games to be at Malibu Bluffs Park in
  2025.

  Commissioner Skophammer left the meeting at 7: 14 p.m.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Recreation Supervisor Orosz provided an update on Charmlee Wilderness Park
  hikes and trail maintenance with Managed Career Solutions.

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on the Swim Team
  Request for Qualifications, Michael Landon Center projects, the Summer
  Recreation Guide, and employee recruitment.

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Commissioner Peak stated rules regarding Commission participation in the
  Community Lands Outreach meetings should have been communicated sooner. She
  stated that the public had not been provided with information regarding the outreach
  meeting agenda or topics. She requested an update on the progress of the Snack
  Shack. She stated Malibu Little League Closing Day Parade would be on June 8.

  In response to Commissioner Peak, Community Services Director Riesgo stated the
  Public Works Director was working on a Request for Qualifications for the Snack
  Shack design.

  Vice Chair Guldimann requested new signs at Legacy Park informing park patrons
  not to feed the ducks.

  In response to Vice Chair Guldimann, Recreation Supervisor Orosz stated it was
  illegal to feed the animals at Legacy Park.

  Commissioner Goldfarb indicated agreement with Vice Chair Guldimann. She
  requested adding a Quick Response (QR) code which could lead people to a website
  with educational resources.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  None.

ADJOURNMENT

  At 7:55 p.m., Vice Chair Guldimann adjourned the meeting.
